LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_ImmediateHintDev: Development mode: parts are created and removed without inventory accounting.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_WorkshopHint: Researched parts use box stock first, then consume materials within 12 tiles of the bench. Removed parts return to the box.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_CommandDescDev: Open the modular weapon interface without a workbench or parts inventory. Development mode only.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_PartUnavailable: {0} must be obtained and placed in the parts box first.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_DiscouragedTopGrip: A grip on the top rail obstructs aiming and offers little benefit.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_DiscouragedBottomSight: A sight under the weapon cannot be used to aim normally.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_SideGripEfficiency: A side mounted foregrip gives 45% of its handling and muzzle control benefit. Only the most effective foregrip adds a benefit; every part still adds weight.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_RailPanelEfficiency: Rail panels improve ergonomics equally on any rail. The second and third panels give half and one quarter of their benefit; all panels add weight.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_SelectWeaponDesc: Choose an equipped modular weapon. Its colonist will walk to this workbench before the modification window opens.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeaponBench_CommandDesc: Choose an equipped modular weapon. Its colonist will come to this workbench to modify it.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeaponBench_NoPartsBox: Insert a weapon-parts box into this workbench.
LanguageData.HD_ModularPartsBox_InsertAtBenchDesc: Order a colonist to carry this box to an available gunsmith table.
LanguageData.HD_ModularPartsBox_NoInstallJob: No reachable empty gunsmith table or available colonist was found.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeaponBench_NoWeapon: No available colonist is carrying a configurable modular weapon.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeaponBench_CannotStart: The selected colonist cannot start weapon modification.
LanguageData.HD_ModularPartsBox_AbsorbDesc: Store modular parts within 8 cells in this box. Small parts are counted; independent parts remain items.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_ExportPresetDesc: Copy a complete preset Def for the current recursive weapon assembly to the clipboard.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_ExportPresetCopied: The weapon preset XML was copied to the clipboard.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_MissingRequiredParts: {0} cannot fire because required parts are missing: {1}.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_GasTubeUnavailable: No installed gas system; the saved setting is inactive.
LanguageData.HD_ModularWeapon_GasTubeDesc: Adjusts the assembled weapon's gas flow. Lower flow reduces cyclic rate and recoil; higher flow increases both. The mechanical RPM limit is never exceeded.
